# netgear Provider

Interact with NETGEAR devices.

The provider drives the undocumented Broadcom FASTPATH CLI, which smart switches expose over telnet on port 60000. The CLI is disabled by default: enable it in the web UI under `Maintenance > Troubleshooting > Remote Diagnostics`.

~> Telnet provides no transport security and the `enable` step is effectively unauthenticated. Reach the switch over a management VLAN only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The `required_providers` block is deliberately omitted so this example
# can also be loaded by acceptance tests using ProtoV6ProviderFactories.
provider "netgear" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cli_flow` (String) Login flow to use: `auto` (default) detects it from the prompt, `modern` expects a `User:` prompt and no enable password, `legacy` expects the username prompt embedded in the interface configuration banner.
- `enable_password` (String, Sensitive) Password supplied at the `enable` prompt. Older firmware prompts and expects an empty string; newer firmware does not prompt at all. May also be set with the `NETGEAR_ENABLE_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `host` (String) Hostname or address of the switch. May also be set with the `NETGEAR_HOST` environment variable.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Login password, the same one used by the web UI. May also be set with the `NETGEAR_PASSWORD` environment variable.
- `port` (Number) TCP port the FASTPATH CLI listens on. Defaults to `60000`. May also be set with the `NETGEAR_PORT` environment variable.
- `save_config` (Boolean) Write the running configuration to NVRAM after each change. Defaults to `true`. FASTPATH applies changes live, so without this they are lost on reboot.
- `timeout` (String) Timeout for connecting and for each command, as a Go duration. Defaults to `30s`.
- `username` (String) Login user. Defaults to `admin`. May also be set with the `NETGEAR_USERNAME` environment variable.
